import numpy as np

def dynamics(t, x, u):
    ball_position = float(x[0])
    ball_velocity = float(x[1])
    beam_angle = float(u[0])
    gravity = 9.8
    ball_acceleration = (5.0/7.0)*gravity*np.sin(beam_angle)
    return np.array([ball_velocity, ball_acceleration], dtype=float)

state_meanings: Ball position along the beam in metres.
Ball velocity along the beam in metres per second.
assumptions: SISO system with one declared control input and one controlled output.
The control input is non-affine because beam_angle appears inside sin(beam_angle).
